court: Court of Justice of the European Union
summary: Operators importing timber into the EU cannot rely solely on national harvesting permits if objective illegality indicators exist in the supply chain.
fraud_pattern: Relying on state concessions without conducting independent supply chain verification or satellite validation.

summary: Mandates verifiable land-titling and proof of harvest date prior to customs release when agricultural frontier encroachment is alleged.
fraud_pattern: Declaring coffee sourced from unmapped buffer zones as certified estate production.

court: Federal Office for Agriculture and Food (BLE Germany)
summary: Confiscation of 240 tonnes teak logs rerouted through Singapore and India with falsified chain-of-custody certificates.
fraud_pattern: Routing illegal timber through non-EU intermediary processing hubs to disguise country of harvest.

court: Dutch Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (NVWA)
summary: Seizure of Amazonian mahogany imported under cloned Documento de Origem Florestal (DOF) logging credits from ghost concessions in Pará.
fraud_pattern: Generating synthetic logging credits on paper and applying them to illegal timber from indigenous reserves.

court: Belgian Federal Public Service Health & Environment
summary: Interception of technical rubber declared as Vietnamese origin but harvested inside protected Cambodian national parks.
fraud_pattern: Smuggling raw latex across unregulated land borders and processing in adjacent country mills as domestic harvest.

court: French Directorate-General for Customs and Indirect Taxes (DGDDI)
summary: Seizure of 180 tonnes raw cocoa beans originating from illegal encroachment inside Cavally Forest Reserve mixed with legal farm beans at San Pedro buying station.
fraud_pattern: Blending illegal buffer zone harvest into registered cooperative bulk batches at local buying centers.

court: Italian Ministry of Environment & Energy Security
summary: Interception of soya shipment whose CAR registration conflicted with official Prodes Cerrado deforestation satellite maps.
fraud_pattern: Using overlapping synthetic CAR polygons to hide post-2020 vegetation clearing.

court: Spanish Agency for Food Safety and Nutrition (AESAN)
summary: Rejection of crude palm oil from Riau whose plantation concession overlapped with protected deep peatlands (>3m depth).
fraud_pattern: Misrepresenting peatland drainage concessions as mineral soil agricultural parcels.
